_readme: Copy to config.json and edit. Keys starting with _ are comments. See README.md for each setting.

camera._streams: RTSP paths after the port. Reolink: h264Preview_01_sub / h264Preview_01_main. Hikvision: Streaming/Channels/102 / 101. Dahua/Amcrest: cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=1 / subtype=0.
camera._pan: PTZ cameras only: an HA sensor with the pan position and the value it has when aimed as calibrated. Remove both for a fixed camera.

_road_polygon: written by tools/calibrate.py from your road outline (pixels in frame_size)

detector._device: usb or pci for a Coral Edge TPU; cpu to run without one (~110 ms per frame on one core)

alert._channel: only for a Discord bot (DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN); not needed with DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL
